adds.title: Delaware SB 65 - conversion therapy ban on minors
adds.summary: Delaware SB 65, introduced 4/26/17 and signed and effective 7/23/18 as Laws of Delaware 81:340, defines conversion therapy to include practices seeking to change gender identity, behaviors or gender expressions and makes it unprofessional conduct subject to discipline for physicians, nurses, mental health and chemical dependency professionals, psychologists, and clinical social workers to perform it on a minor or refer a minor out-of-state for it while prohibiting the Department of Services for Children, Youth and Their Families from performing or recommending it for a minor.

adds.title: Governor Jack Markell Executive Order August 11, 2009
adds.summary: On August 11, 2009, Delaware Executive Order Eight extended anti-discrimination safeguards for state employees and applicants for state employment to prohibit discrimination based on gender identity and reauthorized the Governor's Council on Equal Employment Opportunity with a charge to foster an inclusive environment among executive-branch employees.

adds.title: January 2025 Executive Order establishing LGBTQ Commission
adds.summary: In January 2025 Governor Hall-Long signed an Executive Order creating Delaware's LGBTQ+ Commission.
